passif.description:
Increases all stats of [00D5FF]Goddess allies[-] by [FFAE00]4%[-] for [FFAE00]each[-] one participating in battle.

The hero's basic stats increase by [FFAE00]2%[-] for [FFAE00]each[-] [00D5FF]Buff and Debuff[-] effect active on the battlefield, up to a maximum of [FFAE00]20%[-].

Applies [00D5FF]Mark of Good and Evil[-] on [00D5FF]Goddess allies[-] at the start of the battle for [FFAE00]3 turns[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Mark of Good and Evil: Decreases damage taken by [FFAE00]50 %[-] of the final damage when an enemy's attack results in Crit Damage.
Becomes immune to Stat Decrease.[/i][-]

Applies [00D5FF]Punishing Wave[-] on all enemies at the start of the battle. When the hero [00D5FF]uses a skill[-] to deal damage to an enemy, an additional effect is applied.
[i][C0C0C0]※Punishing Wave: Damage dealt [FFAE00]-20%[-]. (Stacks [FFAE00]3 times[-])[/i][-]

When [00D5FF]Punishing Wave[-] reaches max stacks, they are removed and replaced with [00D5FF]Ripple of Light[-] for [FFAE00]1 turn[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Ripple of Light: Fixes skill damage dealt, including those of Ultimate Moves, to [FFAE00]1[-]. (Limit [FFAE00]once[-])[/i][-]

If the hero deals damage to an enemy with a [00D5FF]single-target attack[-], that enemy will be inflicted with [00D5FF]Mark of Retribution[-] for [FFAE00]3 turns[-].
[i][C0C0C0]※Mark of Retribution: Attack-related stats [FFAE00]-20%[-], Defense-related stats [FFAE00]-20%[-][/i][-]

If an enemy with [00D5FF]Mark of Retribution[-] is [00D5FF]defeated[-] by the hero's [00D5FF]single-target attack[-], [FFAE00]100%[-] of the final damage will be dealt to [FFAE00]1[-] random enemy.
